title: 타다다닥
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie ballad. A clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar plays a repetitive arpeggiated pattern in 4/4 time at 72 BPM in the key of G Major. A soft, breathy female vocal performs a melodic, conversational delivery with light vibrato. A subtle, warm electric bass enters with long, sustained root notes. Minimalist production features high-frequency clarity on the guitar strings and a dry, intimate vocal mix with light room reverb.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[fingerpicked acoustic guitar arpeggio]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
잘 지내요 [bass enters with sustained root notes]
신기하죠 신기하죠
십 년을 매일 떠올리던 사람이
어느 날부터 안 떠오르더라고요
그게 좀 신기했어요
아침엔 눈 뜨면 먼저 생각났는데
이젠 커피가 먼저예요
그것도 신기했어요
근데 그 신기함도 요즘은 잘 몰라요

[Chorus]
잘 지내요 나는 잘 지내요
나라면 진짜가 되니까
잘 지내요 오늘도 잘
